artworks.title: Fagot-makers (Les faiseurs de fagots)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures gathering wood. The image shows a standing figure with a large bundle of sticks gathered in their arms, while another figure is bent over, seemingly engaged in cutting or gathering more wood with a tool. There is a gnarled, leafless tree in the background. The scene is captured with fine lines, conveying an atmosphere of hard labor and rustic existence in a countryside landscape. The drawing is subdued and monochromatic, highlighting the figures and their activity.

artworks.title: Leon Gambetta, 2nd plate
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile view facing left. He has a full beard, mustache, wavy hair styled back, a prominent nose, and expressive eye. The man is wearing a suit, shirt, and bow tie. The background has a textured, horizontal line pattern. The bottom right corner bears the signature "A. Legros."

artworks.title: Head of a Man (Tete d'homme)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person in profile. The person has strong facial features with a pronounced jawline, full lips, and wavy hair that covers the ears and flows down to the nape of the neck. They are looking upward and to the side. The sketch fades away from the shoulders down, and there are no clothing, jewelry, or objects depicted. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed line work of the person's facial features and hair.

artworks.title: Berenice, 2nd plate
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One is a man standing beside a bed, partially concealed by a curtain, looking towards a person lying down. He has a beard and receding hairline, wearing a loose-fitting garment. The other person lies on the bed with eyes closed and mouth slightly open, short textured hair. There are objects on a bedside table, including a vase and a container. The setting appears to be indoors with curtains and a wall with vertical lines.

artworks.title: Shadow (Ombre)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a table. The drawing shows several individuals seated or leaning over a large table, engaged in a discussion. The figures are depicted with gestures, some with their hands raised and others leaning forward or resting their heads. The table is cluttered with various objects, enhancing the composition. The background includes a large, shadow-like form, adding drama to the scene. The drawing features thick, bold lines and cross-hatching, giving it a textured appearance while emphasizing the emotional tension among the group.

artworks.title: The Fire, 2nd plate (L'incendie)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of distressed figures amidst ruins. The background is chaotic, with debris and broken structures. The figures appear to be seeking refuge or in a desperate situation. Light and shadow play highlight their expressions. The composition shows dynamic movement. The cross-hatching technique adds depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Death and the Woodcutter
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on ground wood paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an abstract scene with various indistinct figures and structures. The drawing consists of loosely drawn lines and ink marks creating blocky structures, potentially brick walls or ruins, intertwined with organic forms such as a tree trunk on the right side. The fluid lines hint at forms that could resemble ghostly figures sitting against the structure, possibly in a crouching position. The background features sketchy hatching and cross-hatching, adding texture and shading to the scene. The composition exudes spontaneity and experimentation, lacking a clear narrative or focal point.

artworks.title: Sunset (Le soir (Coucher de soleil))
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees and a waterway viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is at the top, with trees and a sky with cloud forms. The artwork has intricate brushstrokes or etching strokes creating texture in the trees and sky. The color palette is monochrome in black and gray tones, setting a contemplative mood. Light and dark contrasts are achieved through careful use of lines, adding depth to the landscape.

artworks.title: Phrenology Course, 2nd plate (Le cours de phrenologie)
artworks.description: This print shows a lecture scene in an amphitheater-style room. There is a desk on the right with a line of human skulls arranged on it. The people in rows of seats on the left are focused on a bearded man in academic robes who is standing behind the desk, facing the left and raising one arm up, his mouth open. He has pale skin and a balding head. The walls of the room are covered in a grid of thin lines, and a window is partially visible in the top left.

artworks.title: Old Woman Seated (La vieille femme assise)
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an older woman seated, with most of her upper body visible. She is turned slightly to the left, sitting on a bench or similar structure, with her head turned back towards the viewer. Her facial features are detailed, with a furrowed brow and prominent nose. She wears a bonnet with a decorative pattern and a shawl wrapped around her shoulders. Her attire appears warm and layered. The background is heavily lined, suggesting a textured wall or simple surroundings. The artwork is signed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Peasant Woman of Boulogne (Paysanne des environs de Boulogne dite La femme au panier)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated person with deep-set eyes and a prominent nose and chin. The person appears to be an elderly woman wearing a dark cloak or shawl, holding a basket with one hand rested on the handle. The woman's hair is mostly covered by a slightly raised bonnet. The background consists of large stone blocks, suggesting a setting resembling a stone wall or part of a building, casting shadows.

artworks.title: Peasants (Paysannes)
artworks.description: Two elderly women are seated side by side, facing forward with their heads slightly turned towards each other. The woman on the left has defined facial features and wears a headscarf, while the woman on the right also has prominent facial features and her head is draped with a cloth. Both women wear long robes and have a large sack next to them. In the background, there are large tree trunks with foliage, suggesting they are in a wooded area. A distant landscape is visible through the trees. The image is depicted with delicate, sketch-like lines.

artworks.title: Peasants (Paysannes)
artworks.description: The image shows two elderly women seated from the waist up. They are dressed in long, cloaked garments with overlapping fabric. The woman on the left has a headscarf and clasped hands, with a solemn expression. The woman on the right also wears a headscarf and has her hands resting on a sack. The background depicts textured wood paneling on one side and faint foliage on the other. The image has a rustic, monochromatic tone with detailed etching lines.

artworks.title: Traveler taking Shelter (Le voyageur a l'abri)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing next to a tree. Their face is not visible as it is mostly covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The person is wearing a long coat, boots, and holding a walking cane. The background suggests elements like rain or wind, adding a dynamic feel. There are no visible accessories or objects held by the person. The setting seems to be outdoors, with grass-like strokes at the bottom and branches at the top.

artworks.title: English Beggars (Les mendiants anglais)
artworks.description: The image shows four people seated on the ground in a row facing slightly to the right. The individuals include an elderly man with a bushy beard and long hair, a woman with a headscarf, another woman gesturing with her hands extended outward, and a young child. They are positioned against a backdrop of stone walls, wooden fence-like structures, and scaffolding or construction elements. The sky is depicted in a dynamic, linear style. A pathway on the right leads towards a gate or archway in the background.

artworks.title: Finding the Sheep (Le mouton retrouve)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene where a seated figure is tending to a sheep. The point of view is slightly elevated, looking down at the figure. The horizon is low, with a row of trees in the background. Loose brushstrokes or pencil lines are used in the illustration, with detailed cross-hatching around the figure and trees for texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with soft shades of off-white and dark lines. Rustic elements like a tilted chair and a shepherd's crook on the ground complement the rural theme.

artworks.title: Fisherman with a Hoop-net (La peche a la truble)
artworks.description: The image shows a man outdoors, using a long tool to work in tall grasses and shrubs. Two trees stand in the middle, framing the scene. The background features rolling hills with vegetation. The artwork is created using detailed cross-hatched lines and stippling, with a sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Horse-driven Mill (Le manege)
artworks.description: The image shows a horse moving in a circular motion around a wooden post with a supporting structure. Three figures, who appear to be monks, are engaged in various tasks nearby. In the background, there is a slightly hilly landscape with a solitary shrub or small tree. The etching style features intricate crosshatch lines in shades of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: Vagabonds of Montrouge (Les vagabonds de Montrouge)
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing two figures near a rustic path. One figure leans on a walking stick while the other is cloaked. Nearby, a wheelbarrow is on its side with spilled contents. In the background, there are low buildings, fields, and trees leading to the horizon. The landscape is detailed with fine lines and crosshatching, creating a monochromatic appearance in shades of sepia. The color palette is neutral and subdued, typical of etchings, giving the scene an antique feel.

artworks.title: Plague Victims of Rome (Les pestiferes de Rome)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a religious procession comforting the afflicted. The image shows a group of people gathered on a street. Some are seated or kneeling, while others stand. The scene appears to involve a religious or charitable act, possibly providing aid to the poor or sick. On the left side of the image, there are individuals who appear distressed, with one person lying on the ground and another holding a child. Towards the right, a person in religious attire is offering what seems to be a chalice. The procession includes people holding tall candles and a crucifix. The background consists of stone buildings and a rural village setting, with a small animal present in the bottom right. The drawing features detailed linework, creating texture and depth in both the figures and background elements.

artworks.title: Choir in a Spanish Church (La choeur d'une eglise espagnole)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of musicians in an interior space. The scene shows a group of musicians playing and reading music. The central figure holds a larger stringed instrument, likely a bass, and sheet music is spread out before them. Other figures are focused on reading music from large books or participating in the music making, some possibly standing around an organ. The composition is rich with line work and crosshatching, creating a dark, atmospheric setting that reflects the intimate and concentrated nature of the musical gathering. Light and shadow emphasize depth and focus on the musicians and their expressions.

artworks.title: The Refectory (Le refectoire)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of monks seated around a dining table. The scene captures several monks engaged in a meal within a dimly-lit room. The table is covered with a simple cloth and has dishes laid out modestly. There is a sense of communal interaction as one monk appears to be serving another, and some of the other monks are partaking in the meal. In the background, an archway and a crucifix are visible. The drawing is rendered in a detailed cross-hatch style, emphasizing texture and shadow to convey a quiet, solemn atmosphere.

artworks.title: Procession in the Sepulchre of Saint Medard(Procession dans le caveaux de St.-Medard)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people engaged in a processional activity. The figures are shown from the shoulders down, walking from left to right. They are dressed in heavy clothing with bonnets or headscarves covering their hair. Some are holding candles or objects. The background shows a gate on the left and a religious icon in the middle. The inscription at the bottom reads "CAVEAU ST MEDARD PROCESSION."
